channels.label: Single Han token share
channels.formula: count(token exactly one Unicode15 Script=Han codepoint)/T
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Latin letter token share
channels.formula: count(token contains L-category codepoint with Unicode15 Script=Latin)/T
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Decimal-digit token share
channels.catalog_relation: Proxy only; not F033 Chinese-number normalization
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: MATTR100
channels.formula: mean(distinct surface forms / 100) over all length100 contiguous-component windows
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Window normalized lexical entropy
channels.formula: mean(plugin entropy of forms / log2(100)) over same windows
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Adjacent content-token Jaccard
channels.formula: mean(|Kleft & Kright| / |Kleft | Kright|), K=surface forms with POS NOUN/PROPN/VERB/ADJ
channels.opportunity: original adjacent target sentence pairs with nonempty union
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Prior-sentence token trigram reuse
channels.formula: number of sentence-internal trigram positions seen in an earlier sentence in same component / all sentence-internal trigram positions
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Window normalized POS-bigram entropy
channels.formula: mean(plugin entropy of 99 consecutive POS bigrams / log2(17*17)) over length100 token windows
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Mean dependency span
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Sentence-normalized dependency span
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Mean dependency depth
channels.formula: sum(root depth0 path lengths for tokens in T)/T
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Median sentence maximum depth
channels.opportunity: legal sentences with tokens in T
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Candidate predicate heads per sentence
channels.formula: count(POS VERB/ADJ/AUX and root or base relation in ccomp/xcomp/advcl/acl/conj/parataxis)/S
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Subordination arcs per100 sentences
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Conjoined candidate predicate share
channels.formula: count(candidate predicate head and base relation conj)/candidate predicate heads
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Nominal modifier subtree size
channels.formula: sum(per-NOUN/PROPN-head union of nonpunct descendants under acl/nmod children)/number of NOUN/PROPN heads
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: VERB-root with no subject edge share
channels.formula: count(VERB root with no nsubj/csubj child)/VERB roots
channels.opportunity: VERB-root sentences; NOT referential subject sites
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Preposed modifier attachment share
channels.formula: count(dependent rank<head rank)/arcs of base amod/nmod/acl/advmod
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

channels.label: Sentence-initial POS triple reuse
channels.formula: count(initial triple seen in an earlier qualifying same-component sentence)/qualifying sentences except first in each component
channels.opportunity: sentences with >=3 tokens after first qualifying same-component sentence
channels.interpretation_limit: Parser/segmentation-dependent descriptive candidate; not validated style or author evidence.

composition_warning: Components within POS/dependency/cue families are correlated sensors, not independent linguistic constructs. Aliases, masks, denominators, graph edges and quality flags are not additional channels.
missing_policy: null with reason; observed zero only with a positive audited opportunity; no epsilon or zero imputation
model_selection: Final selection and width remain learned and require independent validation; reaching a numeric sensor count does not pass the full-model gate.
